description: Angular component for country autocomplete input, including form control logic, filtering, and UI interactions.

classes.name: CountrySearchData
classes.description: Extends Country with optional searchText property for filtering.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially 'required', updating validators accordingly.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes filteredCountries observable with valueChanges pipeline for filtering countries.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Writes a country value to the form control, updates view and emits code.

methods.name: displayCountryFn
methods.description: Returns display string for a country object.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event, updates validation if dirty.

methods.name: checkInputAndAutoSelect
methods.description: Checks input value, auto-selects country if only one match.

methods.name: textIsNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is non-empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the input field and refocuses.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change, emits country code.
